summary.text: Jon Henry, listed by Ballotpedia as Jonathan Henry, is a Republican state representative from New Mexico who has represented House District 54 since January 1, 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously served as mayor of Artesia and as an Eddy County commissioner.

paragraphs.text: Henry was born in Cloudcroft, New Mexico.
His career experience includes working as an associate broker for Lois Oliver Real Estate and as a restaurant owner.
